final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM patient_counts), shares AS (SELECT patient_counts.ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / total_count AS share FROM patient_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT shares.ID, record_count, share, share - value FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_share WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND share > value ORDER BY share - value DESC LIMIT 10
